latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Adobe Video Editing skill.

- Edit raw video footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV up to 500MB) into polished 1080p MP4 clips.
- Supports video uploads, trimming, transitions, text overlays, and BGM edits via prompt.
- Fast cloud GPU processing (1–2 minutes per clip, shorter clips process faster).
- No need for local Adobe software; all rendering happens server-side.
- User authentication is handled automatically (anonymous token with 100 free credits for 7 days).
- Includes interactive status updates, guided workflows, and easy export/download functions.
